title: Vietnam Aquaculture Feed
thesis: A fictional Vietnamese aquaculture grower runs pond feeding on Snowflake: curated dynamic tables turn daily pond observations into feed uptake, feed-refusal, feed efficiency and auto-feeder KPIs, Snowflake ML ranks next-week feed-refusal risk, and Cortex answers questions with SQL and SOP citations.

talking_points: Thirty synthetic pangasius, shrimp, tilapia and prawn ponds near Can Tho, Long Xuyen, Ca Mau and Soc Trang, with one set of KPIs: feed uptake rate, feed-refusal events, feed efficiency and tonnes of feed dispensed.
Each KPI is computed as an explicit numerator and denominator in a dynamic table, so any figure drills back to pond-day rows. Rations and thresholds are demo settings, not aquaculture guidance.
The cause chart ranks feed-refusal causes by the feed trays they leave uncleared.
tabs.call_out: Feed KPIs the whole team can trace to source

transition.line: Which ponds are most likely to stop taking feed next?

talking_points: A Snowflake ML classification model estimates, per pond, the chance of a feed-refusal event within 7 days.
Its holdout line reports precision and recall on the latest labelled days next to the base rate, so the audience sees how good it really is.
Anomaly detection picks out unusual uneaten-feed days, and a forecast projects the grower's daily feed demand 14 days ahead.
tabs.call_out: Measured ML that runs where the data lives

transition.line: Can we trust the pond data behind these scores?

talking_points: Auto-feeder uptime and auto-feeder coverage show how much of each farm is fed and observed automatically.
Plotting ration review completion against feed uptake rate per pond shows where the two move together; treat it as a correlation, not a cause.
The action memo proposes three prioritised actions, drawn only from the KPI, feed-refusal, cause and risk tables.
show: Ration review completion vs feed uptake rate
tabs.call_out: Draft actions grounded in data, approved by people

transition.line: What if a pond feeding sensor alarms during the meeting?

talking_points: Uneaten feed and feeder hopper level readings arrive in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, either from the built-in simulator or from AWS IoT Core via S3 and Snowpipe.
A Snowflake alert records each ALARM reading with an SOP hint and the pond's risk band, and emails the feed technician on duty.
tabs.call_out: Feeder alarm to technician email on one platform

transition.line: Let's ask the data in plain language.

talking_points: The Cortex Agent combines Cortex Analyst on the semantic view for numbers with Cortex Search on synthetic feed-refusal SOPs for procedures.
Every answer displays the SQL it ran and the SOP IDs it cited.
tabs.call_out: Answers you can check line by line

transition.line: And this is the build behind it.

talking_points: One shared core supports two builds: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake with IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q.
All data is synthetic and regenerated identically from the repository.
tabs.call_out: A governed Snowflake core with an optional AWS edge
